history.recommendation_text: 28. The Board recommends that the Administration strengthen budgetary formulation and control mechanisms to reduce the variances between allocations and expenditure.
history.reference_raw: A/70/5 (Vol. II), chap. II, for the year ended 30 June 2015; para. 326
history.administration_response: The Department of Field Support reiterates that variances are inevitable between appropriations and expenditure when circumstances that were not foreseeable at the time of budget formulation arise during the period of budget implementation. Nevertheless, the Department remains committed to improving budget formulation and management through refined costing requirements, realistic planning assumptions and improvements in budgetary control.
history.board_assessment: On the basis of the reply, the recommendation is considered to have been implemented and to be closed.
